name: Meilisearch 1.58 Search Engine
description: Typo-tolerant full-text, vector and hybrid search API with a master key.

MEILI_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key (16+ characters). Use it to create scoped API keys; never ship it to browsers.

MEILI_ENV.description: production (default) or development (adds the built-in web dashboard; the key is still required).

MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS.description: true turns off Meilisearch's anonymous telemetry.

MEILI_UPGRADE_DB.description: true lets a newer Meilisearch upgrade the database in place (dumpless upgrade).

MEILI_SCHEDULE_SNAPSHOT.description: Seconds between snapshots into /meili_data/snapshots (e.g. 86400). Empty = off.

MEILI_LOG_LEVEL.description: ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG or TRACE.

PORT.description: Port Meilisearch listens on; the public domain and healthcheck use it.

MEILISEARCH_PRIVATE_URL.description: URL for other Railway services: reference ${{Meilisearch.MEILISEARCH_PRIVATE_URL}}.

MEILISEARCH_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL (API; browser search with a search-only key).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Meilisearch gets to finish writes on redeploy.
